startDate.description: The first day of records for the book.

lockOffDate.description: Transactions on or before this date cannot be changed.

entity.description: The id or name of the entity type of business.

industry.description: The id or name of the industry of business.

category.description: The id or name of the industry's category of business.
category.example: Cafes, restaurants and takeaway food services

businessType.description: The id or name of the industry category's business type.

replyToEmailAddress.description: The email address used by clients when replying to emails sent from Reckon One.

showEmailSentFrom.description: The displayed name of sender in emails.

bankDataRetrievalDays.description: The number of most recent days bank data is retrieved for.

example.legalName: Joe Sanders Food Service Pty Ltd

legalName.description: The name of the company that appears on legal documents.
legalName.example: Joe Sanders Food Services Pty Ltd

taxNumber.description: The tax number of the company, for example, 'ABN/WPN' for AU and 'GST/IRD number' for NZ.

branchNumber.description: The branch number associated with the tax number.

businessNumber.description: The business number of the company, for example, New Zealand Business Number (NZBN).

isRegisteredEmployerOfWHM.description: Whether the company is a registered WHM employer.

anyOf.description: Details on how to contact the business to be patched.

contactName.description: Name of person who is primary contact within the business.
